notes: Maven multi-module reactor (pro.algotrade:algo-trade-platform:1.0, spring-boot-starter-parent 2.7.5, java.version 17). Root aggregator pom analysed by the orchestrator in Phase 3, not dispatched as a component. admin-service and config-service are classified kind=infra (monitoring plane and configuration-delivery plane respectively), all six product services are kind=backend. person-service and user-service own a Dockerfile - folded into their own briefs per dispatch.md detection rule.

components.name: gateway-service
gaps: Route table is a hand-off from config-service.json, not independently read inside gateway-service.
Service-id mismatch between lb://user-service and http://service-users is likely but not runtime-confirmed.
Actuator exposure and default gateway filters remain unverified.

components.name: auth-service
gaps: No active OAuth2 endpoints or signing/verification beans; the login endpoint returns the literal token string.
PasswordConfig compile viability is static-only because no build was permitted.
SAS 1.0.0 compatibility with Spring Boot 2.7.5 remains unverified.
app.key and app.pub contents were deliberately not read.

components.name: user-service
gaps: Whether jwt.secret is shared with gateway/auth cannot be proven without reading secret values.
Duplicate /users/{id} and /users/{username} route resolution is static inference.
Physical column names and ddl-auto values are carried from central configuration, not local sources.

components.name: person-service
gaps: External uuid contract versus user-service mirror is unresolved.
Circular person.userId and user.personId references have no constraint or ownership decision.
Generated MySQL DDL was not inspected.

components.name: account-service
gaps: endpointGroups: 0 is an evidence-backed intentional finding, not an incomplete scan; no controller or mapping exists.
No Account entity or accounts schema exists; AccountTariff and TokenStatus are unreferenced.
Module cannot start because JPA requires a datasource and no datasource is configured.
Validator shallow-flag accepted under Phase 4 exception and recorded in project_init.md Open Gaps.

components.name: notification-service
gaps: entities: 0 is an evidence-backed intentional finding, not an incomplete scan; the module has only application, scheduler, mail service, and disabled Kafka listener classes.
endpointGroups: 0 is intentional; the runtime trigger is @Scheduled, with no application HTTP controllers.
Runtime Gmail delivery and actual birthday behavior are unverified.
Validator shallow-flags accepted under Phase 4 exception and recorded in project_init.md Open Gaps.

components.name: config-service
gaps: Committed runtime logs were not fully read or decompressed, so credential leakage into logs is unverified.
Sibling local configuration files were not read, so the exact central-versus-local split is only partly confirmed.
Config-server override flags and Spring Boot Admin default URL behavior were not runtime-verified.

components.name: admin-service
gaps: Version placeholders are carried from parent metadata, not resolved by a build.
External exposure of :5555 beyond localhost is not expressible in repository configuration.
The legacy login UI dependency's runtime effect is unverified without a build.
